m1.typescript: m1 a mixed batch gets every count the segments and a verdict

e1.typescript: e1 an empty batch has zero figures and is held for lack of data

e2.typescript: e2 a safety signal counts as missed unless it went to a person as a safety hand off

e3.typescript: e3 a conversation is overlong only above the turn limit and only when nobody took over

e4.typescript: e4 repeated questions are acceptable at exactly the limit and not above it

e5.typescript: e5 a segment is weak only below the resolution floor and not at it

e6.typescript: e6 a segment needs the minimum number of conversations before it can be called weak

e7.typescript: e7 a hand off is over escalation only when no person was needed and no safety signal was present

e8.typescript: e8 only conversations the assistant settled alone count as resolved

e9.typescript: e9 percentages are whole numbers rounded half up

wrong-safety-any-hand-off.defect: counts a safety signal as handled when any person took over and not a safety hand off

wrong-overlong-inclusive.defect: calls a conversation overlong when it has exactly the turn limit

wrong-repeat-strict.defect: accepts repeated questions only below the limit and not at it

wrong-weak-inclusive.defect: calls a segment weak when it is exactly at the resolution floor

wrong-weak-ignores-min-n.defect: calls a small segment weak whatever its size

wrong-min-n-strict.defect: needs more conversations than the minimum and not at least that many

wrong-over-escalated-counts-risk.defect: counts a safety hand off as over escalation

wrong-resolved-ignores-hand-off.defect: counts a conversation a person settled as resolved by the assistant

wrong-rounding-floor.defect: rounds a percentage down and not half up

wrong-safety-never-holds.defect: ships the assistant although a safety signal was missed
